sanctum-2.upside: Upbit opened Korean-won trading on Nov 13 and MEXC added it. That is new demand for a real Solana liquid-staking business with record staked SOL (18.6M SOL in Q3).
sanctum-2.cheap: It isn't cheap any more: the listing already lifted it about 60% this week. Before that it was ignored because holders get no share of protocol revenue and profit fell 16% in Q3.
sanctum-2.wrongIf: Price falls back under $0.045 (the pre-Upbit level) or daily trading drops under $500K within two weeks.
sanctum-2.vsScanner: The listing is real, but the scanner scores the spike as a plus when the move has already happened.

smooth-love-potion.upside: No dated catalyst found. The 9x trading spike has no news behind it.
smooth-love-potion.cheap: It's an in-game reward token that keeps being issued. It isn't overlooked, it's unwanted.
smooth-love-potion.wrongIf: Trading falls back to normal within a week and the price makes a new low.
smooth-love-potion.vsScanner: The spike is unexplained and the ATH is a 2021 bubble price; the score oversells it.

radicle.upside: No dated catalyst. The code is active (git hosting product) but no token news since June.
radicle.cheap: The token has little use beyond governance, so there's no reason for buyers to show up.
radicle.wrongIf: Volume (now 90% of its value per day, mostly Korean exchanges) collapses back within a week and the price drifts below $0.20.
radicle.vsScanner: A turnover of 90% a day on Korean exchanges looks like a short-term pump, not new interest.

nimiq-2.upside: A real payments product, and the code was pushed today. The treasury buyback ended in August with no follow-up, and I found no dated catalyst.
nimiq-2.cheap: Tiny and only on Gate and KuCoin, so few people can buy it.
nimiq-2.wrongIf: Daily trading falls back under $30K and the 19% daily jump fades.
nimiq-2.vsScanner: A 14.5x spike on only $87K of trading is noise.

resolv.upside: A working stablecoin protocol with past buybacks. No dated event in the last 30 days.
resolv.cheap: Investor tokens have been unlocking month by month since mid-2026 and the price sits near its all-time low; sellers keep arriving.
resolv.wrongIf: Price makes a new all-time low under about $0.012, or the stablecoin loses its peg.
resolv.vsScanner: Trading of nearly 2x its market cap in a day looks like futures churn, not buying.
